verdict.rationale: Canny's developer docs cover embedding Canny's own widget into a customer's app, its API/SDK, and native integrations that push feedback out to third-party tools (Jira, Linear, GitHub, etc.) or connect via MCP to external AI tools — but there is no evidence of a platform, app marketplace, or extension framework letting developers build custom integrations that run/appear directly inside Canny's own interface (dashboard, portal, or admin UI).
